lead.headline: Institutional Capital Pivots to On-Chain Credit and Tokenized Equities
lead.tldr: Massive funding rounds for Morpho and Digital Asset, alongside the SpaceX tokenized IPO, signal a decisive shift from speculative DeFi toward institutional-grade financial infrastructure.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the past week and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Digital Asset Raises $355M in a16z-Led Round at $2B Valuation
top_signals.summary: Digital Asset has raised $355 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, bringing its valuation to $2 billion. The capital will support the expansion of the Canton Network as banks continue to pilot tokenization initiatives.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $2B valuation for Digital Asset confirms that tier-1 VCs view bank-led tokenization networks as the primary bridge for institutional liquidity.

top_signals.title: AI identifies critical bug in Zcash that could have enabled unlimited counterfeit minting
top_signals.summary: An AI-assisted audit identified a critical vulnerability in Zcash's Orchard protocol that could have allowed unlimited counterfeit minting of ZEC. The discovery led to emergency forks and a significant price crash of 38-50%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Zcash vulnerability highlights a critical systemic risk where AI-driven exploits can outpace manual auditing, necessitating AI-native security layers.

top_signals.title: Tether Expands AI push with Lead Role in NEURA Robotics Raise
top_signals.summary: Tether is leading a massive funding round of up to $1.4 billion for NEURA Robotics. The initiative aims to integrate AI technology and cryptocurrency wallets into autonomous robotic systems.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Tether's pivot into robotics suggests a strategic move to embed crypto payments into the physical AI economy, diversifying away from pure stablecoin issuance.

top_signals.title: The head of Aave responds to criticism after a historic liquidity crisis
top_signals.summary: Aave experienced a historic liquidity crisis in April 2026 following an exploit on KelpDAO, resulting in $8.45 billion in outflows over 48 hours. The protocol was saved from collapse via a manual bailout of $300 million.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Aave's liquidity crisis underscores the fragility of interconnected DeFi primitives and the continued necessity of manual intervention in 'decentralized' systems.

top_signals.title: Crypto financial infrastructure company Morpho has raised $175 million in funding, led by a16z Crypto and Paradigm.
top_signals.summary: DeFi lending protocol Morpho has raised $175 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, Paradigm, and Ribbit Capital. The investment values the company at approximately $2 billion and supports its infrastructure for institutional on-chain lending markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Morpho's raise validates the thesis that the next evolution of DeFi is the transition from over-collateralized pools to sophisticated on-chain credit markets.

top_signals.title: The EU's MiCA transition period will end on July 1, and approximately 75% of crypto companies will face elimination.
top_signals.summary: The EU's MiCA transition period ends on July 1, potentially eliminating approximately 75% of crypto companies operating without licenses. Unlicensed firms will face criminal penalties, including imprisonment and fines, forcing a market consolidation toward licensed institutions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The MiCA deadline will trigger a violent consolidation phase in Europe, favoring well-capitalized firms capable of meeting rigorous compliance standards.

top_signals.title: 美国SEC批准T. Rowe Price主动管理型加密ETF上市，最多可纳入15种加密资产
top_signals.summary: The US SEC has approved T. Rowe Price's application to list an actively managed crypto ETF on the NYSE Arca. The fund aims for long-term capital growth by holding a diversified basket of up to 15 different crypto assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SEC approval of an actively managed multi-asset ETF opens the door for diversified institutional exposure beyond BTC and ETH.

top_signals.title: Morpho’s $175M DeFi Round Tests Onchain Credit’s Future
top_signals.summary: Morpho has raised $175 million in a funding round aimed at expanding onchain credit markets. The investment highlights growing investor interest in infrastructure supporting stablecoins and tokenized assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The focus on on-chain credit infrastructure is a prerequisite for the mass migration of traditional corporate debt to the blockchain.

top_signals.title: Ethena Labs to allocate $250 million to Securitize's Tokenized AAA CLO Fund as it deploys on Solana
top_signals.summary: Ethena Labs is allocating $250 million to Securitize's Tokenized AAA CLO Fund. This move coincides with the fund's deployment on the Solana blockchain to provide on-chain access to institutional-grade structured credit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Ethena's allocation to AAA CLOs demonstrates a trend of stablecoin issuers seeking low-risk, institutional-grade yield to sustain their models.

top_signals.title: SpaceX tokenized IPO campaign draws $557M on Binance ahead of debut1h
top_signals.summary: A tokenized IPO campaign for SpaceX has successfully raised $557 million on the Binance platform. This represents a significant intersection of traditional equity markets and blockchain-based asset distribution.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The SpaceX tokenized IPO is a landmark event proving that blockchain can optimize the distribution and liquidity of high-demand private equity.

deals.summary: Digital Asset has raised $355 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, bringing its valuation to $2 billion. The capital will support the expansion of the Canton Network as banks continue to pilot tokenization initiatives.
Tether is leading a massive funding round of up to $1.4 billion for NEURA Robotics. The initiative aims to integrate AI technology and cryptocurrency wallets into autonomous robotic systems.

DeFi lending protocol Morpho has raised $175 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, Paradigm, and Ribbit Capital. The investment values the company at approximately $2 billion and supports its infrastructure for institutional on-chain lending markets.
Figure is acquiring Kiavi for $717 million to expand its real-world asset (RWA) tokenization network. The move aims to migrate Kiavi's assets on-chain to reduce operational costs and enhance margins.

AI infrastructure startup TensorWave has raised $350 million in a Series B funding round. The investment values the company at $1.55 billion and will be used to expand its AMD-powered global AI infrastructure.
Blockworks has acquired Messari, merging two of the largest crypto data platforms. The goal of the acquisition is to develop AI-driven workflows specifically for onchain markets.

on_the_radar.title: Avalanche Treasury Company (AVAT) officially listed on Nasdaq.
on_the_radar.summary: Avalanche Treasury Company (AVAT) has officially listed on the Nasdaq exchange following a merger with a SPAC. The company, led by Bart Smith, focuses on the Avalanche ecosystem and entered the public market via a $675 million deal.

on_the_radar.title: Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: Report2h, Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: ReportJapan’s Lower House reportedly passed a bill that would bring crypto under the country’s financial instruments framework, potentially opening the door to ETFs and lower tax treatment.
on_the_radar.summary: Japan's Lower House has passed a bill to integrate cryptocurrency into the national financial instruments framework. This legislative move is expected to pave the way for the approval of crypto ETFs and more favorable tax treatments for investors.

on_the_radar.title: The CME launches a futures contract on Bitcoin, ether, solana and XRP
on_the_radar.summary: CME Group has launched new futures contracts based on the Nasdaq CME Crypto index. These contracts cover eight major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ether, Solana, and XRP.

on_the_radar.title: The Japanese House of Representatives passed a bill to regulate cryptocurrencies under the same framework as stocks and reduce the tax rate to 20%.
on_the_radar.summary: The Japanese House of Representatives passed a bill to reclassify cryptocurrencies as financial instruments, aligning their regulation with stocks and bonds. This move significantly reduces the maximum tax rate on crypto gains from 55% to 20% and paves the way for the launch of crypto ETFs.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase approved to offer global crypto perpetual contracts in the United States
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase has received approval to offer crypto perpetual contracts to users within the United States. CEO Brian Armstrong noted that this move addresses a long-standing regulatory gap that previously drove U.S. traders to offshore platforms via VPNs.

on_the_radar.title: Mastercard launches AP4M payment infrastructure, enabling AI agents to use stablecoins for small-amount settlements.
on_the_radar.summary: Mastercard has launched Agent Pay for Machines (AP4M), a payment infrastructure designed to enable AI agents to conduct high-frequency, low-value transactions. The system supports stablecoin settlements and integrates with a wide array of major blockchain networks and financial institutions.

on_the_radar.title: Benchmark: Securitize's NYSE IPO imminent, target price $16
on_the_radar.summary: Securitize is preparing for an imminent NYSE listing under the ticker SECZ following a merger with Cantor Equity Partners II. Benchmark has maintained a 'Buy' rating on the company with a target price of $16, citing strong revenue forecasts and a robust global compliance framework.

on_the_radar.title: Japan's three major banks plan to jointly issue a stablecoin by March 2027.
on_the_radar.summary: Japan's three largest banking groups are collaborating to issue a joint stablecoin by March 2027. The project is supported by the Financial Services Agency to modernize the national payment system using blockchain technology.

on_the_radar.title: Japan's three major banks plan to jointly issue a stablecoin in fiscal year 2026.
on_the_radar.summary: Japan's three largest banks are planning to jointly issue a fiat-pegged stablecoin by the end of fiscal year 2026. The banks are establishing a consultative organization to determine commercial applications and have been conducting pilot tests with regulatory support.

on_the_radar.title: HSBC: In addition to Hong Kong dollar stablecoins, it is also considering offering stablecoins denominated in non-Hong Kong dollar currencies.
on_the_radar.summary: HSBC plans to launch a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin in the second half of the year and is considering expanding into non-HKD denominated stablecoins. The initiative aims to integrate stablecoins into HSBC's app to facilitate tokenized asset investments and optimize cross-border transfers.

on_the_radar.title: Wallets linked to Humanity Protocol drained for over $32 million, token plunges 89%: onchain analyst
on_the_radar.summary: Wallets associated with Humanity Protocol were drained of over $32 million, leading to a massive 89% crash in the project's token price. On-chain analysis reveals that a significant portion of the stolen funds has already been swapped for Ethereum.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock’s new tokenized fund puts Ethereum’s institutional thesis to the test
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock has launched a new tokenized fund, utilizing the Ethereum blockchain to facilitate institutional asset management. This move serves as a critical test for the institutional thesis regarding Ethereum's utility as a settlement layer for real-world assets.

worth_a_read.title: Hester Peirce Bids Farewell to the SEC After Nearly 30 Years
worth_a_read.note: Essential for understanding the shifting regulatory climate at the SEC following the departure of a key internal skeptic.

linkedin_post:
Institutional Web3 is no longer a theory—it is being funded in the billions. This week, we saw a massive capital influx into on-chain credit (Morpho) and bank-led tokenization (Digital Asset), alongside a landmark $557M tokenized IPO for SpaceX. The signal is clear: the market is moving away from speculative DeFi primitives toward the 'plumbing' of global finance. However, this transition isn't without friction. The looming MiCA deadline in the EU and critical AI-driven vulnerabilities in legacy protocols like Zcash remind us that compliance and security are the only real moats in this industry. We are entering a phase of violent consolidation where only the licensed and the secure will survive. The question for founders is no longer 'can we build it,' but 'can we institutionalize it?'

Is the industry ready for the consolidation MiCA will trigger, or will it stifle innovation in Europe? #Web3 #Tokenization #VentureCapital #MiCA
